raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the source goal is that the station runs the review sweep and settle detection once for every session on the node and that settle reads the latest resume stamp; this delta keeps that landing and repairs the four findings the prior review carried — reckon/crew/station.py:121 names one sweep owner per session, reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:139 makes a stale reading no answer, and reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:74 gives the has-live-work rule one owner.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_reflex_runs_once_in_the_station.py with the sweep-count, settle-window, quiet-resume and traceless-path measures; the manifest records 26 passed EXIT=0 at ac82617e5 in logs/armed2-head.log and EXIT=4 (file absent) at base 9e363fe50 in logs/armed2-base.log, with the importer arms at 490 passed plus 1 parallel-arm flake against 503 passed.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/station.py, reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py, tests/test_the_reflex_runs_once_in_the_station.py and the evidence fragment, with reckon/crew_follow_commands.py recorded as a widen; every path in the delta from 4b2994225 to ac82617e5 is among them.
VERDICT manifest: read at the reviewed run's manifest.md; it records the armed gate pair, the importer arms, the 60 s trace pair, the eight-mutation negative control and the ruff delta, and its ruff claim holds when measured at ac82617e5 — SIM103 at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:90 and SIM115 at :1228 are the only findings and both pre-date the ruff fix, while crew_follow_commands.py is unformatted at base 4b2994225 and at head alike.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from 4b2994225 to ac82617e5; five commits, 280 insertions and 102 deletions over five files — the live-work rule consolidated into station_subscriber.live_work_populations, live_work_verdict returning None for a stale or unreadable reading with crew_follow_commands._is_live falling back to the pointer listing, and station._sessions_to_sweep choosing one owner per session from its first-sorted pointer.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/station.py:319 (live_work_populations in Station.tick), reckon/crew/station.py:343 (_sessions_to_sweep in Station.tick), reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:585 (_population_has_live_work delegating to station_subscriber.population_has_live_work), reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1629 (_is_live reading subscriber.live_work with the None fallback at :1632), reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:2196 (_population_has_live_work in the arming loop)
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/station.py:121 and reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:139 answer the prior review's split-session and stale-reading defects, though the station and the watcher now hold two different host-sweep rules at reckon/crew/runs.py:3960.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: logs/armed2-head.log records 26 passed EXIT=0 at ac82617e5 and logs/armed2-base.log exits 4 because the node's file is absent at 9e363fe50, so the base comparison rests on the importer arms (logs/importers2-base.log, logs/importers2-head.log) and the eight-mutation log rather than on the armed pair.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the delta from 4b2994225 is inside the manifest's declared write paths or the widen it records for reckon/crew_follow_commands.py, and no unrelated file is touched.
SCORE durability: 16
JUSTIFICATION durability: all three added cases redden under the recorded mutations (logs/negative-control2.log), and test_one_rule_decides_live_work_for_the_station_and_the_producer judges the station's persisted reading against the rule recomputed from the test's own pointers rather than against a value it passed in.
SCORE fit: 15
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/crew/station.py:141 reaches into recovery_liveness._record_is_known_foreign as before, and the docstring at reckon/crew/station.py:129 says "first-sorted live run" where the min ranges over every live pointer including terminal-phase ones.
SCORE reuse: 11
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the live-work judgement is now correctly owned once, but station._sessions_to_sweep restates the host-sweep ownership that reckon/crew/runs.py:3916 sweep_unfollowed_sessions already owns and contradicts it, so one capability now has two rules.
FINDING reckon/crew/runs.py:3960 non-blocking: sweep_unfollowed_sessions still skips a session that holds any foreign pointer — the exact split-session defect this delta repairs at reckon/crew/station.py:121 — so the watcher path at reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:2898 and reckon/crew/runs.py:4047 still leaves a session split across hosts unswept, and the repository now carries two contradictory host-sweep rules; it is outside the node's write scope, so it should be folded into a follow-up node rather than repaired here.
FINDING reckon/crew/station.py:129 non-blocking: the docstring calls the owner "the session's first-sorted live run", but the min at reckon/crew/station.py:141 ranges over every pointer in the live directory, terminal-phase ones included (tests/test_the_reflex_runs_once_in_the_station.py writes phase="complete" into live/ and the rule sees it), so a terminal run's host can be chosen as the owner; the evidence fragment repeats the same wording.
FINDING reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:174 non-blocking: live_work_reading has no production caller after StationSubscriber.live_work moved to live_work_verdict, so a bool-only view of the same reading survives only for tests, which is the kind of parallel surface this section exists to remove.
